Officials from the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] have received word of our sharing of technological data with the [pre_ftl_country.GetName]. They have informed us that this is a clear violation of the Exploitation Act, regardless of our intentions.

# 违反开发利用法案 / Breach of Exploitation Act
- 分类 Category：文明纪事 Society (C7) · 星系共同体前FTL决议 galactic community pre-FTL resolution
- 来源 Sources：`events/first_contact_dlc_situation_events.txt:8293-8346` · `common/resolutions/03_resolutions_first_contact_dlc.txt`
- 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-13（c7b-society）

## 如何开始 How it starts

每五年脉冲（on_five_year_pulse_country，`00_on_actions.txt:473`）：星系共同体成员，当“剥削法”生效、本方对某前FTL国家实施开放科技启蒙（或曾违反），且近 3600 天内未被罚过。 / Five-year pulse: a Galactic Community member under an active Exploitation Act that shares technology with a pre-FTL country (or has violated it), not fined in the last 3600 days.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

**违反剥削法（10250）**：共同体得知我们向原始文明分享了科技数据，已违反法案；唯一选项“该死！”，罚款 5000 能量。 / The Community learns of our tech sharing and fines us 5000 energy.
